scope: Full production scene with real physical E, GUI keyboard events and phase controller. 28-storey 2D selectors are measured at 1152x720 and 640x480; scroll clipping and focused last destination visibility are distinct from offscreen scroll content. Actual 3D button and glyph AABBs are projected into the operating panel YZ bounds. Doors are measured from actual MeshInstance3D transforms; labels, active Camera3D, passenger bounds/control and finite differences of logical travel are independently observed. Passenger remains fixed inside a detached opaque car; logical floor progress is not physical travel through source slabs. Scenario starts and landing obstruction are explicit test-only fixtures. Headless defers native viewport captures; safety faults are also retained in check_building_visits. User settings and running native game are untouched. No human-input, whole-city route, surveyed shaft or performance/export acceptance.
